description: You are the content marketing manager at NestWell, a home décor brand. Create a CMS Static Block with identifier 'autumn-collection-featured', title 'Autumn Collection Featured Products', status Enabled, and HTML content including an h2 heading, a paragraph, and a list of at least 3 product categories. Then create a CMS Page titled 'Autumn Collection 2024' with URL key 'autumn-collection-2024', status Enabled, layout 1 column, meta title 'Autumn Collection 2024 | NestWell Home', and page content that embeds the static block using {{block id="autumn-collection-featured"}}. Both items must be saved. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
